nodes.title: Vertex on vp-voice from the India VM, new key. Text: gemini-3.5-flash-lite, 3.6-flash and 3.8-flash all 200 (0.95-1.67 s for 5 tokens). TTS: gemini-3.8-flash-tts 200 (2.07 s, whole clip) and 3.8-flash-lite-tts 200 (1.65 s), so both ARE on Vertex generateContent, contrary to the docs reading; 3.1-flash-tts-preview 20.1 s; 2.5-flash-tts 3.06 s. Live: gemini-3.8-live gives setupComplete only at us-central1 (2.08 s including connect). It reports 'not found' in europe-west4, europe-west1 and asia-south1, gives 404 on the us/eu hosts, and refuses TEXT output ('Unsupported modality for Vertex Live API'). gemini-3.5-transcribe-live-preview and gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview are 'publisher model not found' at us-central1 and europe-west4. TLS connect is about 30 ms to every aiplatform host.
nodes.n: 1 request per model/region (about 22 in all, spaced about 2 s apart)
nodes.method: Run Command probe scripts on vl-vm-cin (Central India) with the service account's bearer token: generateContent (global) and the Live websocket setup (LlmBidiService v1), reading close reasons. No call came from the sandbox.

nodes.title: Gemini ears are retired: Vertex offers no Gemini transcription model, and Live refuses text-only output. Ears go to Azure Speech (Central India, streaming hi-IN), per the routing rule that what Azure has goes to Azure. The lab's round-2 stacks (v2-flashlite, v2-54mini, v2-38flash, v2-mai, v2-luna) now listen with Azure Speech. The older Gemini-ears presets show unavailable, with a reason. VERTEX_MODEL_MAP maps gemini-3.5-transcribe-live to null.
nodes.rationale: The probe found 'publisher model not found' for the transcribe model in both regions, and 'Unsupported modality' for TEXT out on 3.8-live. Azure Speech was measured at 0.45 s from India. One measured weakness: a quiet elderly 'hmm' was missed (ledger.LAT-06).
nodes.reverse_if: Vertex lists a Gemini transcription model for vp-voice, or measured Hinglish WER or turn-taking on Azure ears is clearly worse than another available ear (Sarvam Saaras, or gpt-4o-transcribe on Azure).

nodes.method: voicelab/tests/sim_caller.py on the VM against the deployed lab: synthetic Hinglish caller clips (g5 battery), 3 turns, scenario renewal. Cost from the lab meter.

nodes.title: VERTEX_LIVE_LOCATION=us-central1, the only region where gemini-3.8-live set up for vp-voice. The owner accepts processing outside India (directive.2026-10-22.processing-anywhere).
nodes.reverse_if: Live set-up succeeds in a nearer region (europe-west4 or asia-south1), measured by the same probe.
